about: Who checks each fault kind of a stick-man film: a machine gate (tool + gate), the AI reviewer (review/final-qa.md at ◇5) or Kai. A row's checker is the one whose measured result catches the kind; Kai keeps what neither catches reliably. whochecks.mjs renders this into the make-reel-stick-man GATES.md and checks a complaint map against it.

checkers.machine: a tool that must exit 0 at the gate (GATES.json run), or a render that shot.mjs refuses
checkers.ai: the independent AI review at ◇5 (review/final-qa.md); advisory until its brief passes calibrate.mjs, and never in place of Kai at K2
checkers.kai: Kai watches at 1x on a phone and says OK or names the shot

rows.fault: a joint snaps to a new pose and holds
rows.limit: a change of 75 px or more (720-tall frame) that stays 3 frames; a spike gone within 2 frames only shows on the strip
rows.source: Kai marked 12 strips 17/11: only a fault held 3 frames was seen; replay S3-032 hit

rows.fault: a prop appears, vanishes or resizes inside a shot and stays
rows.limit: a prop over 0.2 % of the frame, changed 75 px or 15 % in size, held 3 frames
rows.source: replay S3-037 hit (v002 F784)

rows.fault: a released prop falls without weight
rows.limit: vertical acceleration off gravity by 0.6 g for 3 frames, within 15 frames of the hand letting go
rows.source: replay S3-039 hit (v002 F860)

rows.fault: a figure slides with no real steps
rows.limit: the body travels over 0.6 m/s for 8 frames while the stiller foot near the floor moves over half as fast
rows.source: replay S3-045 hit (v002 F1064)

rows.fault: a body or prop passes through the set or another body
rows.limit: 6 px or more into an opaque surface, held 3 frames
rows.source: Kai saw strip 10 (11 px for 3 frames) 17/11; replay S3-046 hit (v002 F1214)

rows.fault: a prop passes through a head, or sits inside a wall, a piece of furniture or a jamb
rows.limit: a hand-sized prop's inset box 2 cm or more into a head ellipsoid or a set solid (box meshes + COLLIDE), 6 px, held 3 frames
rows.source: Hot Money ep01 r5 v3 LOAD-A: bag in the head 18 f, in the dresser, the bed and door 9's jamb (bench rows, PR kit/correct-hm-r5)

rows.fault: one arm of a figure passes through its other arm
rows.limit: an arm's axis within one arm thickness of the other arm's (the two hands meeting left out), 6 px or more into it, held 3 frames
rows.source: Kai 23/11, Hot Money ep01 split: you's left elbow in the right upper arm 1885-1893, 9 f (test/fixtures/hm-ep01)

rows.fault: an arm (hand, elbow, forearm, upper arm) passes through a counter, a wall or a piece of furniture
rows.limit: a point along the arm over 1 cm inside a set solid (box meshes + COLLIDE; a hand on its target or holding a prop left out), the drawn arm 6 px or more in, held 3 frames
rows.source: Kai 23/11, Hot Money ep01 City Bank: you's left forearm through the counter top's front edge 1908-1914, elbow and hand clear (test/fixtures/hm-ep01)

rows.fault: a prop in a hand leaves the frame while its holder stays in it, and comes back
rows.limit: seen whole in the 6 frames before, out of the frame 3 frames or more, back within 45
rows.source: Hot Money ep01 r5 v3 LOAD-B 691-714, 741-757: the bait bill out of the top of the frame

rows.fault: a tracked prop drawn at a size its real kind never has (a round bigger than the gun)
rows.limit: longest side outside kit/props/sizes.js REAL_SIZE by 1.25x, in view, 6 px, 3 frames; untracked objects are not seen
rows.source: Hot Money ep01 r5 GUN: round 14 cm beside a 23 cm slide

rows.fault: an object cut by the camera's far plane inside the shot (a straight edge in the sky), or a set's flat sky card over the engine's sky dome
rows.limit: an opaque mesh 2 m tall or more reaching past far with its near part in view, 6 px, 3 frames
rows.source: Hot Money ep01 r5 CHASE 1481-1513, 1613-1637: motel.js sky cards 220 x 60 m at 60-70 m, far 80 m (review/r5/p2/f1)

rows.fault: a face design Kai has not seen on a face sheet
rows.limit: any expression design held 15 frames on a readable head that is not in review/faces-approved.json
rows.source: Hot Money ep01 r5 s1 round 2 (19/11 22:49): new faces shown in the film first, rolled back

rows.fault: a figure pops into the frame or to a new place
rows.limit: a jump of 75 px or more that stays 3 frames
rows.source: replay S3-050 hit (v002 F1372); Kai did not see a 120 px one-frame jump 17/11

rows.fault: too many hard cuts, takes too short
rows.limit: at most 4 hard cuts in any 15 s, one take of 6.5 s or more
rows.source: Kai picked the bible cut (4 cuts, 6.7 s) over v7 (11 cuts) 17/11; v002 16 cuts in 15 s fails

rows.fault: the camera looks up at the lead too often
rows.limit: at most 25 % of frames looking up over 5° at the lead's head
rows.source: bible 1 % and v7 5 % passed, an old pilot at 53 % fails; no rejected Hot Money cut has camera rows

rows.fault: the lead's face is cut off by the frame
rows.limit: no run over 1 s with less than half the head in frame
rows.source: Kai 12/11 note; no rejected sample with camera rows yet

rows.fault: the same face comes back too often
rows.limit: a non-neutral face in more than 2 takes
rows.source: kai-taste Repeats; v7 rows: y_strain 5 takes fails (S3-053)

rows.fault: a face the beat's words never name
rows.limit: held 0.5 s or more on a readable head
rows.source: v7 rows: 1 off the beat (SH340); no 16/11 note caught

rows.fault: a hand-keyed move where the motion library has a clip
rows.limit: any such move blocks the render of a Hot Money film
rows.source: v7 16 of 156 actions from the library, blocked; bible cut 68 %, passes; Kai prefers the bible cut 17/11

rows.fault: a head squashes or a bone stretches in a library clip
rows.limit: head 15 % when its volume holds, else 5 %; bone length 3 %; knee and elbow -2° to 160°
rows.source: Kai picked option B 17/11; 0 of 52 clips over since #132

rows.fault: the colour jumps at a cut or dims inside a shot with no light that motivates it
rows.limit: at a cut |luma| 25 and |sat| .15 in one scene, 50 and .25 at a scene change; 25 luma in 0.5 s inside a shot; a light event in colour-script.json exempts it
rows.source: Hot Money ep01 r5 A v6 colour audit 21/11: LOAD-A dims 57 with no cut, LOAD-B +63 at a cut; Kai approved the gate 21/11

rows.fault: a shot drifts from the approved colour script: a cast, washed out, hazy blacks, a dim hero white, an off-palette hue or one hue flooding
rows.limit: per scene in colour-script.json (defaults R/B 0.8-1.6, S .25-.7, black 10-26, hero white >= 175 at R/B .95-1.10, off-palette <= 20 %, a flood of 90 % <= 3 s); film mean luma >= 100, dark seconds <= 15 %
rows.source: Hot Money ep01 r5 A v6 colour audit 21/11: R/B 1.9 in LOAD-A, day two S .21 and hero 162-167; Kai picked amber + police blue 21/11

rows.fault: the film is too dark or one hue drowns it
rows.limit: caught in both briefs, on a note the brief quotes (an upper bound)
rows.source: AI trial 17/11: S3-058 hit 2 of 2; colourgate.mjs measures luma and hue only against the film's own colour script, so a script that approves a dark or one-hue film still needs this review

rows.fault: the same camera angle over and over
rows.limit: C5: at most 3 takes of one angle family (side around the lead, low / eye / high, close / medium / wide) in any 5 takes in a row
rows.source: AI trial 17/11: S3-060 hit 2 of 2 with no camera rows; Hot Money ep01 A v9 banks: 3 back, eye-level, medium takes in a row, inside the 80 % Kai approved 20/11

rows.fault: glare or burnt highlights at phone size
rows.limit: R1: at most 3 % of the frame over Y 235 over any 0.5 s
rows.source: Kai A v3 19/11 'quá chói, cháy sáng' in 7 of 9 segments (takes 4-33 %); A v9 2.1 %

rows.fault: the lead too dim against the background, or too small to read on a phone
rows.limit: R2: head Y / ring Y >= 0.9 in every take the lead holds 0.5 s; R3: head under 18 px at 640 for at most 3 s
rows.source: guesses to recalibrate; A v9 0.98 and 0.9 s

rows.fault: the film goes empty under its words: holes of near silence, a bed far under the voice, a closing question with nothing under it
rows.limit: F1 no run under -30 dBFS for 0.3 s outside a planned silence; F2 the bed never more than 18 dB under the voice for 4 s; F3 the last 6 s at least as full as the film's median bed; advisory at ◇5
rows.source: Hot Money ep01 v15 (19 holes, bed 34 dB under the voice, YouTube drop at the bank explanation) against H2 V2.1 (none), 24/11

rows.fault: a hit quieter than the next class or the voice, off the picture, or missing
rows.limit: S1 order of the sound plan; S2 attack within 90 ms early / 185 ms late (ITU-R BT.1359); S3 no hit under -40 dBFS in the sfx stem; advisory at ◇5 until S2 is checked by ear
rows.source: Kai 18/11 cheap SFX, 19/11 the first slam missing; A v9 S2 flags the glass smash

rows.fault: motion that feels jerky or stiff with no pose that snaps and holds
rows.limit: no detector
rows.source: S3-035: 0 joint pops in its window; AI 0 of 2

rows.fault: a prop jumps or vanishes across a cut
rows.limit: shotgate.mjs now blocks a held prop that jumps 15 cm off its holder's carry or vanishes at a cut inside one scene (prop jumps / vanishes at cut), but no complaint has a measured hit yet: Kai keeps the row
rows.source: S3-038 largest prop jump 2.9 px, S3-040 no prop gone after the cut (v002, its rows gone, not replayable); AI half on S3-038, 0 on S3-040; Hot Money ep01 A v9 rows: 0 at-cut faults

rows.fault: a held prop drags the arm, as if it holds the person
rows.limit: no detector
rows.source: S3-047: 0 grip faults in its window; AI half in one brief

rows.fault: cords or cloth jitter
rows.limit: cord shake is shown, never blocks
rows.source: S3-062: CORD_SHAKE_MAX is not a gate; slice rows are gone

rows.fault: a face that does not fit the moment, or flickers between faces
rows.limit: facebeat.mjs reads only the beat's words
rows.source: S3-041 and S3-043 AI 0 of 2; v002 faces use names facebeat.mjs cannot read

rows.fault: an effect or prop of the wrong size or kind
rows.limit: no detector
rows.source: S3-048 and S3-049 AI half in one brief

rows.fault: a face or action lost at phone size: blank, covered, a confusing shape
rows.limit: cutgate.mjs C4 sees only the frame edge
rows.source: S3-044, S3-051, S3-052 AI at most half

rows.fault: too much text on screen
rows.limit: prepro.mjs counts card time, not words on screen
rows.source: S3-059 never replayed

rows.fault: the whole film's feel: frustrating, no climax
rows.limit: no detector
